dataset: GaitRec -- large-scale ground reaction force dataset of healthy and impaired gait
citation: Horsak B, Slijepcevic D, Raberger AM, Schwab C, Worisch M, Zeppelzauer M. GaitRec, a large-scale ground reaction force dataset of healthy and impaired gait. Scientific Data 2020;7:143. doi:10.1038/s41597-020-0481-z.
files_used: GRF_F_V_PRO_left.csv (processed, BW- and time-normalised vertical GRF)
selection: CLASS_LABEL in {HC,A,K,H,C}; SHOD_CONDITION==1 (standardised footwear); SESSION_TYPE==1 (initial-presentation baseline); SPEED==2 (self-selected -- the only speed at which the pathology classes were recorded). One per-subject mean curve.
